description: selfFactSpec rows (v1 as a committed data file) read at use time by development-vessel's self_fact_reconcile from the git object origin/dev:scripts/substrate/self-facts.json in each node's super-repo clone. A row registers one instrument (a fact function in self-fact-reconcile.ts): the node profiles whose node holds the copies it checks, the edit site its gaps point at, and its must-fail control. An instrument with no row does not run. REALIGNMENT 2026-09-29 §2.1 items 1, 3, 4, 5.
